summary: 86-year-old Sandy Carpenter, hiking with a group of eight above the Caribou Trailhead, slipped and fell, injuring her wrist and pelvis and unable to walk; Nederland Fire and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group brought her down ~1.5 miles in a technical wheeled evacuation to the parking lot, and AMR transported her to the hospital.
responding_agency: Nederland Fire Protection District; Rocky Mountain Rescue Group; Boulder County Sheriff's Office; American Medical Response
notes: Date stated explicitly in Mountain-Ear article ('On June 29, 2016').
